column3: Halt! Who goes there?{end_wait}
I've stood here all day.\nHow did you get inside?{end_wait}
Doesn't matter.\nYou're not staying.{end_wait}
You heard him.\nTurn around and leave.{end_wait}
Who are you?{end_wait}
How did you slip\npast the outer guard?{end_wait}
Don't care.\nYou're leaving now.{end_wait}
And don't come back.{end_wait}
Did you hear that?\nSomeone's nearby.{end_wait}
You're hearing things.\nBut this place {text_effect:2}is{reset_text_style} creepy.\nI don't like it.{end_wait}
No one's getting inside.\nSo why do they keep us\nstanding here all night?{end_wait}

Hammet brings us more
than any caravan.
Keep the merchant safe.{page_break}Dodonpa wants him alive.
Alive and paying.{end_wait}
Z-z-z...\nJust a moment.\nI'll open my eyes...{end_wait}
Dodonpa gave an order.\nNo one gets through.\nNot even another guard.{end_wait}
Colosso must be over\nby now. I could've\nbeen watching it.{end_wait}
Someone just passed me.\nI'm certain of it.{page_break}No... I'm exhausted.\nThat's all it is.{end_wait}
If someone tries\nto get past, I'll\nmake them regret it.{end_wait}
I never asked to stand\nguard down here.{page_break}What if an intruder comes?\nWhat am I supposed to do?{end_wait}
Who's waking me?{end_wait}
Who's there? Let me sleep!{end_wait}
Stop that noise!{end_wait}
Intruder! Over here!{end_wait}
Thought you'd get past me?{end_wait}
Then fight your way\nthrough. Come on!{end_wait}
Who's there?{end_wait}
You walked into\na fortress of thieves.\nBold choice.{end_wait}
You should've turned back.\nNow it's too late.{end_wait}
Shift's over already?{end_wait}
Wait. I don't know you.{end_wait}
You're no guard.\nSound the alarm!{end_wait}
You won't get past me!{end_wait}
You! Stop right there!{end_wait}
Dodonpa warned us\nsomeone might come\nlooking for Hammet.{end_wait}
If I catch you,\nhe'll finally notice me.{end_wait}
You've made my day.\nNow hold still!{end_wait}
Donpa barely leaves\nhis bed these days.{page_break}What Dodonpa has done\nis eating him alive.{end_wait}

We were brought here
against our will.{page_break}The others keep quiet.
I just want to go home.
Once more, if I can.{end_wait}
Wh{pause_20_skippable}-Who goes there?{end_wait}
Y-You're not a guard!{end_wait}
You don't look like\none of Dodonpa's men.{end_wait}
Did you come here\nlooking for someone?{end_now}
Hammet?\nI don't know where\nthey've hidden him.{end_wait}
Then why would you\nrisk coming here?\nNobody visits for fun.{end_wait}
I won't call the guards.\nBut get out before\nthey find you.{end_wait}
They sealed the caves\nafter the merchant\nwas brought here.{end_wait}
If Donpa dies,\nnothing will restrain\nhis son anymore.{end_wait}
Donpa would set us free.\nHe always cared\nabout the people here.{end_wait}
Who are you?{end_wait}
You think that's the one\nwho came for Hammet?{end_wait}
Has to be.\nLook at the others.{end_wait}
They've got some nerve.\nI'll give them that.{end_wait}
Dodonpa will have\nour heads if Hammet leaves!{end_wait}
Don't let them escape.\nWe'll pay for it!{end_wait}
You're not taking\nanother step!{end_wait}
You're stronger than\nwe thought. Fine!{page_break}We're done fighting.\nJust get out of here!{end_wait}

All right, we surrender!
Hammet's in the caves
beneath the fortress.{page_break}Go find him yourself.
Just leave us alone!{end_wait}

Don't hit me again!
You want Hammet?{page_break}He's in the caves.
Go down there and get him.
See how far you make it.{end_wait}
That was a mistake.\nWe never should've\nfought those four.{end_wait}
Hammet's in the caves.\nGetting to him\nis another matter.{end_wait}
They'll never find\nthe door switch.{page_break}It's hidden in the wall.\nLet them keep searching.{end_wait}

Donpa hasn't been well.
His son's driven him
to his bed.{page_break}I wouldn't disturb him.
Not with his temper.{end_wait}
Where has Dodonpa gone?\nNot to his room.\nNot outside, either.{end_wait}
Another round!\nHammet's paying,\nwhether he knows it or not!{end_wait}
Kalay keeps sending gold.\nWhy let Hammet go?{page_break}A prisoner worth money\nis better than a customer.{end_wait}

Who could challenge
Donpa and live?{page_break}Nobody goes near
the caves these days.
I wonder why.{end_wait}
His wife is looking\nall over the fortress.\nShe can't find him.{end_wait}
All this food came\nfrom Kalay's ransom.{page_break}I could get used\nto this life.{end_wait}
Keep Hammet here.\nWe'll drain Kalay dry.\nThat's Dodonpa's plan.{end_wait}
Z-z-z...{end_wait}
Father, forgive me.\nI should've stopped\nDodonpa myself.{end_wait}
Quiet! Don't wake Donpa.{end_wait}
He's been worn down\nby a terrible struggle.\nHe needs his rest.{end_wait}
All of this\nbecause of Dodonpa.{end_wait}
Are you the one\nDonpa asked to punish\nhis son?{end_now}
He's been waiting\nfor someone willing\nto face Dodonpa.{end_wait}
You're not?\nThen please, help us\nanyway.{page_break}No one else will.{end_wait}
Donpa knows he spoiled\nhis son for years.\nHe blames himself.{end_wait}
He can't rest\nwhile Dodonpa rules\nthe fortress this way.{end_wait}
If someone stood up\nto Dodonpa, perhaps\nLunpa could breathe again.{end_wait}

Donpa would reward
anyone who put
his son in his place.{page_break}The thief has plenty
of ill-gotten treasure.{end_wait}
Have you seen Dodonpa?{end_now}
He's in the fortress?\nAll right. I was worried\nhe'd gone outside.{end_wait}
He's vanished again?\nDon't tell me\nhe's chasing women.{page_break}His wife will be furious.{end_wait}
Papa makes Mama cry.\nI have to behave\nso she won't cry more.{end_wait}
Papa talks to ladies\nwhen Mama isn't looking.{page_break}She always finds out.\nHe never learns.{end_wait}

That child has learned
to be quiet and good.
Far too young.{page_break}He shouldn't have
to grow up this fast.{end_wait}
Donpappa is next\nin line to lead Lunpa.{page_break}I hope he doesn't\ntake after his father.{end_wait}
When I grow up,\nI'll protect Lunpa.\nNo one will fear me.{end_wait}
When I grow up,\nI won't marry anyone\nlike my papa.{end_wait}
That boy watches\neverything his father does.\nI wonder what he thinks.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} pulled\nthe switch.{end_wait}
